tha-ap218:1.1: Saṇṭhita.] Assatthe haritobhāse saṃvirūḷhamhi pādape / ekaṃ Buddhagataṃ saññaṃ alabhissaṃ patissato. // //
tha-ap218:2.1: Ekatiṃse ito kappe yaṃ saññam alabhiṃ tadā / *duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhasaññāy' idaṃ phalaṃ* / tassā saññāya vāhasā patto me āsavakkhayo. // //
tha-ap218:3.1: Ito terasakappamhi Dhaniṭṭho nāma khattiyo / sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahabbalo. // //
tha-ap218:5.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Saṇṭhita thero i. g. a-ti.
